text:
emma: Quick Q — customer with Private (VPC) deployment wants us to include cloud infra charges on a single Redwood invoice. Are we set up to do pass-through for provider bills + platform fee? @sofia FYI.

raj: short answer: we can, but it depends on deployment model. If customer manages VPC (self-hosted), they pay cloud directly. If Redwood manages the deployment (we own cloud accounts or link billing), we can surface provider line items as passthrough or bundle them. Need SOW/legal.

sofia: Customer explicitly asked for one invoice (platform + cloud) and wants committed discounts applied across the bundle. They asked whether we can show provider line items (instance, region, egress) on the invoice.

matthew: Licensing/SOW note: our Enterprise master allows Redwood to invoice managed infra + platform as a single bill, but we must: (1) disclose passthrough items and source, (2) get explicit acceptance in SOW, (3) handle tax/treatment per jurisdiction. No hidden markup unless approved.

infra-bot: cluster-reporter: dedicated-pool-east-1 utilization=87% (72h avg); spare_gpus=12; projected shortfall if +2 managed private clusters onboarded within 30d.

raj: Ops detail — if we commit reserved capacity for a customer to support "managed Private", we'll need to: reserve a dedicated pool (region-bound), possibly buy RI/committed-use discounts, and reflect those costs in our billing model. Quick sketch: 

```
# per-month example estimate (east-1)
2 x a100 (reserved) = $6,000 / mo
Network egress ~ 10 TB @ $0.12/GB = $1,228 / mo
Redwood managed platform fee = $4,500 / mo
Pass-through margin = 0% (customer requested)
Total billed = $11,728 / mo
```

olivia: For invoicing we need explicit line items: provider name, region, instance type, hours, GB egress, unit price, subtotal. Also customer VAT settings and billing address.

emma: Action items: matthew to draft SOW passthrough clause, raj to produce per-region cost calc (us-east, us-west, eu-west), infra to mark candidate pools for reservation/commit, sofia to confirm customer acceptance of itemized invoice. I'll assemble a single-invoice prototype.

sofia: I'll ask the customer if they accept provider-level transparency. They prefer a single bill but want committed discount on the platform fee. Will update by EOD.

matthew: Draft clause (working): "Customer accepts passthrough charges for third-party cloud provider services as invoiced by Redwood Inference, itemized separately; Redwood may apply markup only if expressly agreed in writing."

raj: Operational risk to call out: cross-region data transfer costs — if customer VPC spans regions or our managed nodes are in a different region, egress may be charged twice (provider -> provider). Recommend explicit line in SOW and invoice template: "cross-region data transfer billed at provider rates."

emma: Good point. Add that to prototype invoice + SOW. Thanks team. :+1:

infra-bot: note: scheduled capacity review with eng-ops on 2025-11-10 16:00 UTC to confirm reservation plan.

olivia: I'll prepare invoice XML template with fields requested and share in #finance-files.

sofia: update: customer ok with passthrough transparency but asked for a 6-month trial of zero-markup — asked legal to confirm.

matthew: I'll confirm trial terms, and add tax/dispute language.

emma: Closing for now. Will post prototype invoice link when ready.
